text: ぼうそうぞく…　よく　みかける　けど　こわそうで　いやだわ
note: ぼうそうぞく (bōsōzoku) are Japan's real youth motorcycle gangs, known for riding loud, modified bikes in groups. The English game just calls them bikers.
claim: Bōsōzoku are a Japanese youth subculture of motorcycle gangs known for riding loud, customized motorcycles in groups.

check.quote: Bōsōzoku (暴走族, lit. 'reckless driving group') is a Japanese youth subculture associated with customized motorcycles. ... removing the mufflers on their vehicles so that more noise is produced. ... bōsōzoku would often embark on massed rides, in which up to 100 bikers would cruise together slowly en masse down an expressway or major highway.
